body: Bro really brought that classic sound back After experimenting with the $TARFACE sound, Tyga returns to what he does best on “Balcony. ” The new track brings back his signature West Coast bounce, with catchy production and the effortless flow that made his earlier hits so popular. It’s a reminder of why fans have been rocking with this side of Tyga for so long. tyga rap hiphop.
